network_configuration_review.request: Мне не нравится, что в коде присутствуют локальные IP адреса типа 127.0.0.1:50053. Давай сразу оформим красиво и правильно (с точки зрения бизнес разработки и безопасности).
decisions: FL_GRPC_ADDR is mandatory: no IP/port literals or implicit network fallback in application Go source. Missing/empty address fails before bind with sanitized JSON and exit 1.
Local and container profiles are explicit nonsecret configs/env/*.env.example files; application itself does not load dotenv.
Separate listener configuration, future peer DNS targets and host publication. Container wildcard is explicit, not an automatic fallback or authentication policy.
Default toolchain has no published ports. Manual development instructions publish only on host loopback; unqualified host publication removed.
Personal *.env files are ignored by Git and excluded from Docker build context, including nested dotenv files.
Loopback in isolated test fixtures and observed logs is intentional and not a deployment default. TLS/mTLS, runtime images and client service discovery remain future work.

f09.protocol: Read monotonic lease generation G -> initialize transactional producer using stable lane ID -> claim lease only by CAS on that same G; no producer reuse after failed CAS and no reinit under old generation
f09.ordering: One unacknowledged version per stream per Kafka transaction; next version only after confirmed Kafka commit and durable SQL mark; cross-stream batching allowed
f09.limits: Contenders can fence a live publisher and hurt availability; client automatic epoch recovery must be excluded for stale lease; PostgreSQL/Kafka boundary still permits duplicate event IDs
f09.future_checks: A pause/resume and B takeover, delayed init/CAS, lost commit/SQL mark, retry/reinit, read_committed, inbox/version guards; F09 remains open until implemented and verified

presentation.preserved_contracts: Distinct SQL generation and Kafka epoch; read G -> broker init -> CAS same G; no reinit under old lease; independent post-commit delivery and SQL mark; inbox+durable job before offset, version/state guards in worker transaction
presentation.validation: Seven Mermaid sequence diagrams rendered with Mermaid 11.4.1 and visually inspected; local documentation links and safety checks passed; this is document validation, not runtime validation of the proposed protocol
